Olmesartan-Induced Enteropathy: Case Reports and Insights From FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS). Olmesartan, an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) approved in 2002, is used to treat hypertension, either alone or with other antihypertensive drugs. It has been frequently associated with sprue-like enteropathy, while few cases of colitis have been reported.
